summary: Aeva Technologies filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for a public follow-on offering of 4,494,382 shares at $22.25 per share, with a 30-day over-allotment option for 674,157 additional shares. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under an automatically effective Form S-3. Net proceeds are estimated at $94.4M ($108.7M if over-allotment exercised). The offering is expected to close on June 5, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a standard capital raise, not a special situation; the filing does not reflect an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or any other listed special-situation category.
